isolationMethod.A: re-split pool: drop every kind=atkadd factor from the hit fold set, then recompute M, base and the ln(f)/ln(M) shares from the remaining folds only.
isolationMethod.B: pool-preserving: keep the current M/base/pool and the current shares of every non-atkadd rule; redirect only the atkadd shares that WERE resolved to an owner back to the attacker baseCredit. Unresolved atkadd shares stay unattributed.
isolationMethod.note: A and B are different re-accounting conventions; neither simulates replacing a character.
